primary_content.metric: all four answers correct in an episode
primary_content.required: Every registered seed, task and base condition; stress tests reported separately
primary_content.comparison: Addressed Flow versus addressed diagonal with common initialization, information, typed-address prior, state capacity and training data
primary_content.old_architecture_control: Legacy Flow and causal Transformer are freshly trained on identical streams; parameter and persistent-state differences disclosed

intervals.method: Paired hierarchical bootstrap: resample training seeds, then shared episode identifiers within each seed; retain cross-arm pairing
intervals.limitations: Only three independent training seeds; bootstrap degenerates with all-success or all-failure observations and is not proof of population certainty

control_2x2.A: addressed diagonal, development-selected lightweight price threshold
control_2x2.B: addressed diagonal, common task-value READ controller
control_2x2.C: addressed Flow, same lightweight price threshold
control_2x2.D: addressed Flow, same common task-value READ controller
control_2x2.target: Mean four-query correctness minus quoted READ price; all actual READ/STOP counterfactual continuations retained
control_2x2.cost_separation: Symbolic task price, training/calibration CPU, evaluation counterfactual CPU and measured inference latency are distinct; no CPU-to-joule conversion
control_2x2.selection: Content checkpoints frozen first; common controller trained on separate train trajectories; lightweight threshold selected on dev; policy frozen before control confirmation

continuous_dynamics.interpretation: Clock intervention changes supplied time but retains the world's labels; it is not numerical resampling. A time-use effect alone is not analytical-core superiority.

cost.aggregation: Disjoint outer-meter receipts only; nested fit and decoder timers are reported but never added twice
cost.energy_gate: Unmet unless a real attributable meter is available

adoption: Requires valid content, real frontend quality, matched analytical increment and deployment economics. Completing runs is not satisfying capability or adoption gates.
failure_policy: Preserve every failed run and original condition; repairs before confirmation create new source/protocol identities; do not retune after inspecting confirmation.
